relevant_files.purpose: Single-file Node.js script: logs into 强智 教务 via app.do authUser, fetches timetable week-by-week via app.do getKbcxAzc JSON API, converts each course entry (kcsj/kssj/jssj/jsmc/jsxm/kcmc) to an iCalendar VEVENT. README confirms 适用于强智教务系统.

protocol_approach: This repo does NOT parse the 强智 web timetable HTML (no xskb_list.do, no .kbcontent, no HTML regexes). It uses the 强智 mobile-app JSON API instead: POST-free GET login at /app.do?method=authUser&xh=&pwd= returning a token, then /app.do?method=getKbcxAzc&xh=&xnxqid=&zc= queried once per week (zc=1..31). Odd/even-week (单/双周) courses are handled implicitly by the per-week loop — a course only appears in the weeks it actually meets — rather than by parsing week-token strings. Day coordinate is taken as the first character of the kcsj field (weekday 1-7), mapped to an absolute date by adding day-1 to the configured first-semester Monday.
exact_regex_or_code_snippet: url: `http://${conf.site}/app.do?method=getKbcxAzc&xh=${conf.xh}&xnxqid=${conf.xnxqid}&zc=${zc}` ; login: url: `http://${conf.site}/app.do?method=authUser&xh=${conf.xh}&pwd=${conf.password}` ; day mapping: let day = data[event].kcsj.slice(0, 1); curday = monday.add(day - 1, 'day'); ; only regexes present are time-formatting: data[event].kssj.replace(/:/, '') and data[event].jssj.replace(/:/, '')
verdict_reason: Genuinely a 强智 (QiangZhi) timetable-to-ICS exporter confirming the vendor's ecosystem, but it implements the app.do mobile JSON protocol variant (getKbcxAzc/authUser), not Sleepy's claimed xskb_list.do + .kbcontent HTML parsing form; it contains zero HTML regexes and zero 单/双周 token logic, so it neither matches nor contradicts the specific claim.

sleepy_claim_check.强智 xskb_list.do + .kbcontent 解析形态: differs vs this repo — repo uses /app.do?method=getKbcxAzc (mobile JSON API, per-week zc loop with implicit odd/even handling) instead of xskb_list.do HTML form with .kbcontent cells and 单/双周 token parsing
